title: Language Learning Practice Bot
description:
Language learners rarely get enough speaking and writing practice with someone who corrects them patiently. A practice bot should hold role-play conversations in everyday situations at the learner's level and point out mistakes with short explanations.

Constraints: replies must match the learner's level (CEFR A1 to C2); corrections must be shown separately from the conversation so the role play keeps going; speech input and output are useful but optional; automatic speech recognition confidence is not a pronunciation score and must not be presented as one.
goals:
• Offer several everyday scenarios with the bot staying in its role
  • Show corrections with a short explanation in the learner's native language after every message
  • Adapt vocabulary and sentence length to the selected CEFR level
  • Support spoken input and spoken replies as an option, with words that were not clearly understood flagged for repetition
  • Give a list of all corrections at the end of a session
